name: Musée Vivant (Living Museum)
subtitle: A site near the lake, almost in the heart of the capital, showing traditional Burundian life and animals.

facts.label: Location and theme
facts.value: Near Lake Tanganyika; dedicated to traditional life in Burundi.

facts.label: Purpose
facts.value: Display of artistic, cultural and animal heritage.

facts.label: Animals (2018)
facts.value: Guide listed six crocodiles, a leopard, two chimpanzees, an antelope and snakes.

parts.text: A site near the lake, almost in the heart of the capital, showing traditional Burundian life and animals. It was created to display the artistic, cultural and animal beauty of Burundi.
